summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement to acquire TopBuild Corp. for stock consideration, with a two-step structure merging TopBuild into a QXO subsidiary. Terms: each TopBuild share converted into QXO common stock (exchange ratio not explicitly stated); no cash or per-share price provided. Both boards unanimously approved; QXO's board recommended the share issuance. The deal includes customary conditions. Watch for stockholder votes and regulatory review; risk-arb monitors exchange ratio and closing timeline.
